# Hello! <i class="bi bi-emoji-laughing"></i>

Welcome to my research profile website. I'm a student in the Intro to Reproducible Data Analysis Using R course.

## About Me <i class="bi bi-person-raised-hand"></i>


**Name:** Morgan Yashchenko (yuh-SHEN-koh)<br>
**Institution:** University of Oklahoma Health Campus<br>
**Research Interests:** T cells and neutrophils in Polycystic Kidney Disease<br>
**Email:** morgan-yashchenko@ou.edu<br>

## My Research <i class="bi bi-beaker"></i>

I'm interested in understanding how immune cells and inflammation promote rapidly progressing Polycystic Kidney Disease. Through this course, I've learned how to:

<ul style="padding-left: 1rem; margin-left: 0;">
  <li>Use R for data analysis</li>
  <li>Create reproducible research workflows</li>
  <li>Build websites to share my work</li>
  <li>Manage my research projects with Git and GitHub</li>
</ul>

## This Website <i class="bi bi-globe"></i>

This site showcases my research and projects. Check out my **Projects** page to see my final report and other work!

As my research progresses, I'll continue adding:

<ul style="padding-left: 1rem; margin-left: 0;">

  <li>Achievements and awards</li>
